1560: Mitzcha degulegalta, mitzcha leitpakkeda (sefer acher laatapekarea) chayyayvayya al ovadehon. vechad hay mitzcha itgalyay, mitarin marehon dedinin, leinnun dela mitkassefin beovadehon. hay mitzcha sumaka kevavrda. uveshaata deitgalyay mitzcha deattika behay mitzcha, ithadderat chivvavra ketalga. vehahi shaata, et ratzon ikre lecholla.
Besifra deagadta deve rav yeva sava amar, metzach. zache metzach, mitzcha deattika. vei lav, ashde 8 ben teren atvavn, kema deat amer (Bamidbar 24:17) umachatz paate moav.

Veokimna, deikre netzach beatvavn retzufin. vechamma netzachim havo. veaf al gav denetzach achara (beatra) benetzach ochora istellak, veit netzachim ochoranin demitpashshetin bechol gufa. uvegin deshabbeta beshaata ditzlota demincha, begin dela yittear dinin, galya attika kadisha mitzcha dileh, vechol dinin itkafyayn veishtechachu vela itavidu.

Behay mitzcha talyayn 24 batte dinin, lechol innun dechatztzifin beovadehon. kema dichtiv, (Tehillim 73:11) veamru echa yada el veyesh dea veelyon. veha esrim innun, 4 lamma. lokovlehon ded mitot bet dina letatta, detalyayn milleella. veishtaaru esrin. uvegin kach la maanishin be dina illaa, ad deyashlim (nusach acher asrin) vesalleka lech shenin, lokovlehon dech batte dina. bematnita setimaa dilan tanenan, lokovlehon dechd sefarim deitkelilan beorayyta.

Ayynin deresha, innun ayynin dela mistammerin minnayyhu chayyayvayya. ayynin denayymin vela nayymin. uvegin kach ikru (Shir HaShirim Adonai:12) enav keyonim. may yonim. kema deat amer, (Vayikra 25:17) velo tonu ish et amito. veal da ketiv, (Tehillim 94:7) vayyomru lo yire yah vegomer. uchetiv (sham) hanota ozen halo yishma vegomer.
Tikkuna deal ena, sare demittesharan beshiura shelim. meinnun saarin talyayn elef vez mea mare deashgachuta, leagacha kerava. ucheden kayyme kullehu mishshuleshlehon umitpakchin ayynin.

Kesuta deal ayynin, gevinin mitachadan behu. veelef (10 mea) ribbevavn mare terisin itachadan behu, veinnun ikrun kesuta deayynin. vechol innun deikrun ene Adonai, la pakchin, vela ittearun, bar bezimna deillen kesute digvinin, mitparshin innun tattae meillae. uveshaata deitparshan gevine tattae meillae, veyahavin atar leashgecha mitpakkechin ayynin, veitchazze keman deitar mishshenateh (mishnateh). istacharu ayynin vechama leena pekicha, veistachan bechivvavra dileh. vechad istachyayn, itkafyayn marehon dedinin leyisrael. uvegin kach ketiv, (Tehillim 44:24) ura lamma tishan Adonai hakitza vegomer.

Arba gavvnin itchazyayn beinnun ayynin. meinnun nehirin 4 batte ditfilin, denaharin birhite mocha. 7 deikrun ene Adonai. veashgachuta (nafka) nafke, miggevavn uchama deena. kema deokimna beidara, dichtiv, (Zecharya 3:9) al even achat shiva enayim. veinnun gavvnin mitlahatin besitrayyhu.

Missumaka, nafkin ocharanin, mare deashgachuta ledina. veinnun ikrun, (divrei hayamim 2 16:9) ene Adonai meshottot bechol haaretz. meshottot, velo meshottim. begin dechullehu dina. miroka, nafkin ocharanin, dekayymin legallaa ovadin, ben tav uven bish. dichtiv (Iyov 34:21) ki enav al darche ish. veillen ikrun, (Zecharya 4) ene Adonai meshottim. meshottim, velo meshottot. begin deinnun litren sitrin, letav ulevish. mechivvavra, nafkin kol innun rachame, kol innun tavan, demishtachche bealma, leotava lehu leyisrael. ucheden istachyayn (nusach acher istacharan) kol innun telat gevavne, lerachama alayyhu.

Illen gavvnin mitarvin da beda, veitdabbekan da beda. kol chad ozif lechavreh miggevavne dileh, bar mechivvavra, dechullehu kelilan beh kad itzterich, vehu chafe al kolla. kol gavvnin diltatta, la yachlin kol bene alma, leaschara lon chivvavra, leuchama lesumaka veliroka. vehacha beashgachuta chad, kullehu itachadan veistachyayn bechivvavra.
1561: Gevinoy la mishtakkechin, bar kad bayayn gavvnin dechivvavra leashgacha, begin digvinin yahavin atar leashgacha, lechullehu gevavne. vei innun la yahavin atar, la yachlin leashgecha uleistakkela. gevinin la kayymin, vela mishtakkechin shaata chada shelemuta (shelemata), ella pakchin vesatmin, satmin ufakchin, mishshum ena pekicha dekae alayyhu. veal da ketiv, (Yechezkel 1:14) vehachayyot ratzo vashov. veha okimna.

Ketiv (Yeshayahu 33:20) enecha tirena yerushala 40 nave shaanan, uchetiv (Devarim 11:12) tamid ene Adonai elohecha bah mereshit hashshana vegomer. deha yerushalam baya ken, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 1:21) tzedek yalin bah. uvegin kach yerushala 40, vela tziyyon. dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 1:27) tziyyon bemmishpat tippade vegomer, decholla rachame.

Enecha, enach ketiv, ena deattika kadisha, setima decholla. hasheta, ene Adonai elohecha bah, letav ulevish, kema deitchaze. (lasevamekaa valeyrevakea. vehacha beashgachuta chada, kullehu asecharen vaasatechayyn bechivvavra. gabeynevay lo mashetakekayn, bar kad bayayn gavvnin leashgacha) begin kach la itkeyaymu bekiyyuma tadir. vehatam enecha tirena yerushala 40, kolla letav, kolla berachame. dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 54:7) uverachamim gedolim akabbetzech.

Tamid ene Adonai elohecha bah mereshit hashshana. mereshit chaser 1 ketiv, vela reshit bealef. man hi. hei diltatta. uleella ketiv, (Eicha 2:1) hishlich mishshamayim eretz tiferet yisrael. may taama hishlich mishshamayim eretz. mishshum dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 50:3) albish shamayim kadrut, veayynin bekadruta, begavvna uchama itchafu.

Mereshit hashshana, mean atar mistakkelin biyrushalam illen ene Adonai, chazar uferash, mereshit hashshana, dehu dina bela alef, vedina itachad missitraha, af al gav delav hu dina mammash. vead acharit shana, acharit shana vadday dina ishtechach. deha ketiv, (Yeshayahu 1:21) tzedek yalin bah, dehi acharit hashshana.

Ta chaze, 1 bilchodoy ikre rishon, dechar. bealef satim veganiz ma dela ityeda. kad itchabbar hay alef baatar achara, ikre reshit. vei tema deitchabbara. la. ella itgalya beh, venahir leh, ucheden ikre reshit. vaafillu behay reshit, la ashgach biyrushalam, deilmale havat behay, itkayyaymat tadira. aval mereshit ketiv. ulealma deate ketiv, (Yeshayahu 41:27) rishon letziyyon henna hinnam vegomer.

Chotama dizer anfin, tikkuna defartzufa. kol partzufa beh ishtemoda. chotama da, la kechotama deattika kadisha setimaa dechol setimin. dechotama deattika, chayyim dechayyim lecholla. deha mitteren nukevin, nafkin ruchin dechayyin, lecholla. behay zeer anpin ketiv, (Shmuel 2 22:9) ala ashan beappo vegomer.

Behay tenana kol gevavne (tere gevavne) achidan beh, bechol gevavna ugevavna, achidan kama marehon dedina kashya. daachidan behahu tenana. (uvegin kach) vela mitvassemin kullehu, ella bitnana demadbecha diltatta. veal da ketiv, (Bereshit 8:21) vayyarach Adonai et reach hannichoach. mahu hannichoach. itbassemuta demare dina, nachat ruach. vayyarach Adonai et reach hannichoach, et reach hakkarban la ketiv, ella et reach hannichoach. dechullehu gevuran daachidan bechotama, vechol deitachadan behu, kullehu mitvasseman. vechamma gevuran mitachadan kachada, dichtiv (Tehillim 106:2) mi yemallel gevurot Adonai yashmia kol tehillato. vehay chotama, mechad nukeba nafak eshsha deachla kol shear eshshin. bechad nukeba tenana. vehay vehay ishtechach beeshsha utenana demadbecha. veitgalyay hay attika kadisha, veishtechach kolla. hayeynu deittemar (Yeshayahu 48:9) utehillati echotam lach.

Chotama deattika kadisha arich, umitpeshat. veikre erech appayim. vehay chotama, zeer. vechad tenana share nafik bivhilu, veitavid dina. uman meakkev lehay. chotama deattika. vecholla kema daamena beidara, veitaru chavrayay.

Uvesifra derav hamenuna sava, okim hane tere nukeve. mechad tenana veeshsha. umechad nayycha verucha tava. deit beh yemina usemala, uchetiv (sefer acher dichtiv) (Hoshea 14:7) vereach lo kallevanon. uvenukeba ketiv, (Shir HaShirim 7:9) vereach appech kattafuchim. uma benukeba hachi, kol shekken beh. veshappir kaamar.
1562: Uma deamar vayyarach Adonai et reach hannichoach. hannichoach bitre sitre, chad nayycha, deitgalyay attika kadisha setima dechol setimin, dehay hu nayycha veitbassemuta lecholla. vechad itbassemuta diltatta, behahu tenana veeshsha demadbecha. uvegin deihu mitteren sitrin, ketiv nichoach. vecholla bizer anfin ittemar.

Tere udenin, lemishma tav uvish. vetarvavyyhu sallekin lechad. dichtiv, (Melachim 2 19:16) hatte Adonai aznecha ushama. udena lego bego dileh, talyay birshimin akimin, begin deyitakkav kala leaala bemocha, veyavchin beh mocha, vela bivhilu, dechol milla dahave bivhilu, la hava bechachmeta shelemata.

Meudenin illen talyayn kol marehon degadfin, denatlin kala mealma, vechullehu hachi ikrun azne Adonai, dichtiv behu, (Kohelet 10:20) ki of hashshamayim yolich et hakkol vegomer. ki of hashshamayim yolich et hakkol, hay kera kashya, hasheta may kol ikka hacha, deha resha dikra ketiv gam bemaddaacha melech al tekallel, bemaddaacha ketiv, uvechadre mishkavcha vegomer. may taama ki of hashshamayim yolich et hakkol, veha lekka hacha kala.

Ella vadday kol ma dechashiv bar nash, vechol ma deyistekal belibboy, la avid milla, ad deappik leh besifvavteh, vehu (veaf al gav deihu) la itkevvavn beh. vehahi milla deappik, mitbekaa baavira, veazla vesalleka vetasa bealma, veitavid minneh kala. vehahu kala natlin leh mare degadfin, vesallekin leh lemalka, veayyil beudenoy. hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim Adonai:25) veyyishma Adonai et kol divrechem. (Bamidbar 11:1) veyyishma Adonai vayyichar appo.

Uvegin kach, kol tzelota uvauta devae bar nash mikkamme kudesha berich hu, bae leappaka millin besifvavteh, dei la appik lon, lav tzeloteh tzelota, velav bauteh bauta. vechevan demillin nafkin, mitbakkein baavira, sallekin vetasin veitavidu kala, venatil lon man denatil, veachid lon leatra (nusach acher lechitra) kadisha, beresha demalka.

Mittelat chalale demoche, natif netifa leudenin, vehahu ikre nachal kerit. kema deat amer, (Melachim 1 17) nachal kerit, kelomar, keruta deudenin. vekala ayyil behahu akima, veishteav behahu nahara, dehahu netifa. ucheden itakkav tamman, veitbechin ben tav levish. hada hu dichtiv, (Iyov 34:3) ki ozen millin tivchan. umay tama ozen millin tivchan. mishshum deitakkav kala behahu nahara dintifa, baakimuta deudenin, vela ayyil bivhilu. uvegin kach itbechin ben tav levish, (sham) vechech yitam leechol. may tama chech yitam leechol. begin deyitakkav tamman, vela ayyil bivhilu begufa, veal da yitam veyitbechan, ben metika limriru.

Behay nukeba deudenin, talyayn nukevin ocharanin, nukeba deayynin. nukeba defuma. nukeba dechotama. mehahu kala deayyil benukeba deudenin, i itzterich ayyil lenukeve deayynin, venavin dimin. mehahu kala i itzterich, ayyil lenukeba dechotama defardashka, umappeke tenana veeshsha mehahu kala. hada hu dichtiv, (Bamidbar 11:1) veyyishma Adonai vayyichar appo vattivar bam esh Adonai. vei itzterich, ayyil hahu kala lenukeba defuma, umallil vegazar millin (nusach acher gizrin) mehahu kala. kolla mehahu kala deudenin. ayyil bechol gufa veitregish minneh kolla. (sefer acher kema talyay) (vecholla talyay) behay udena. zakkaa man denatir milloy. al da ketiv, (Tehillim 34:14) netzor leshoncha mera usefatecha middabber mirma.

Hay udena kare beh shemia. uvishmia itkelilan innun moche. chachma itkelil beh, dichtiv, (Melachim 1 3:9) venatatta leavdecha lev shomea. bina, kema deat amer (Shmuel 1 3:10) dabber ki shomea avdecha. (Melachim 2 18:26) ki shomim anachnu. (uvehane talyayn kolla) daat, kema deat amer, (Mishlei 4:10) shema beni vekach amaray. (Mishlei 2:1) umitzvotay titzpon ittach. ha kolla talyayn beudenin behay udena talyayn tzelotin uvautin ufekicha deayynin. hada hu dichtiv, (Melachim 2 19:16) hatte Adonai aznecha ushama pekach enecha uree. ha kolla beh talyay.
1563: Behay udena, talyayn razin illain, dela nafkin levar, begin kach hi akima lego. veraza derazin setimin beh, vavy lehahu megalle razin. uvegin dehay udena kanish razin, vaakimuta dilgo natil lon, la galle razin leinnun daakimin bearchayyhu, ella leinnun dela akimin. hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 25:14) sod Adonai lireav uverito lehodiam, denatle archoy venatle (venatre) millin.

Veinnun daakimin bearchayyhu, natle millin veayylin lon bivhilu, velet behu atar leitakkeva. vechol nukevin acharanin, mitpattechin beh, ad denafkin millin benukeba defuma. veillen ikru chayyayve dara, senue dekudesha berich hu. bematnita dilan tenan, keillu katil guverin, ucheillu palach leavoda zara. vecholla bechad kera, dichtiv, (Vayikra 19:16) lo telech rachil beammecha lo taamod al dam reecha ani Adonai. man deavar al hay resha dikra, keillu avar al kolla.

Zakkaa chulakehon detzaddikayyay, dealayyhu ketiv, (Mishlei 11:13) veneeman ruach mechasse davar. neeman ruach vadday, deha rucha dilhon meatar illaa kadisha ishtelif, uvegin kach neeman ruach ikrun. vesiman da okimna, hahu dimgalle razin, beyadua denishmateh, lav ihu miggufa demalka kadisha. uvegin kach let beh raza, vela meatar deraza hu. vechad tippuk nishmateh, la itdabbeka begufa demalka, deha la atreh hu. vavy lehahu bar nash, vavy leh, vavy lenishmateh. zakkaa chulakehon detzaddikayyay, dimchassin razin, kol shekken razin illain dekudesha berich hu. (razin illain demalka kaddisha) alayyhu ketiv, (Yeshayahu 60:21) veammech kulam tzadikim leolam yirshu aretz.
1564: Anpoy, kitrin takrovin devusema. (kullehu) sahaduta al ma daamena, deha sahaduta behu talya. uvecholla talya sahaduta. aval hane takrove devusema, chivvavra vesumaka, sahaduta leabba veimma. sahaduta leachsena deyarit veachid lon. veha bematnita dilan okimna, kama parse ben chivvavra lesumaka, veitkelilan beh kachada besitra dechivvavra.

Kad itnehir minhiru dechivvavra deattika, chafyyay hahu chivvavra al sumaka. vechullehu binhiru ishtechach. ucheden ketiv, (Bamidbar 6:25) yaer Adonai panav elecha. vechad chayyayvin sagiin, talyayn dinin bealma, ishtechachat segiruta becholla (sefer acher bealma). vesumaka itpeshat beanpin, vechafa kol (nusach acher al) chivvavra. ucheden kolla ishtechach bedina. ucheden ketiv (Tehillim 34:17) pene Adonai beose ra. (bigde kina ketiv 4 bigde nakam) vecholla behay talyay, uvegin da sahaduta hu becholla.

Kama vechamma mare terisin mechakkan lehane gevavne, metzappan lehane gevavne. kad nehirin gevavne, kol almin kullehu bechedu. bezimna denahir chivvavra, kolla itchazu behahu gavvna. vechad itchaze besumaka kolla hachi itchazu behahu gavvna.

Beillen takrovin devusema, shari dikna leitchazaa, meresha deudenin, venachit vesalik betakrova devusema, saarin uchamin dedikna, betikkuna yae shappir. kegibbar takkif, shappir. mishcha dirvut dedikna illaa deattika, behay dikna dizer anfin itchaze, venahir.

Shappiru dehay dikna, bet tikkunin ishtechach. vechad mishcha dirvut, ditlat asar neviin dedikna deattika kadisha nahir behay dikna, ishtechachu 22 tikkunin. ucheden mitbarchin kullehu. veyisrael sava mitbarcha behay, vesiman, (Bereshit 48:20) becha yevarech yisrael. kol tikkunin dedikna da, okimna beidara kadisha, dechullehu mitikkunin deattika kadisha ittekanu. vehacha baena legallaa, ma dela itgele tamman, begin lemeal bela kissufa. (ha kol tikkunin dadeykenaa okimna dechullehu mateykevaneyn dadeykenaa 1 attika kaddisha okimna baidra kaddisha)

Shita innun, 9 ikrun. tikkuna kadmaa, nafak hahu nitzotza butzina dekardinuta, uvatash bitchot saara deresha, mittechot kotzin deal udenin, venachit mikkamme pitcha deudenin ad resha defuma. ha tikkuna da meattika kadisha la ishtechach, ella kad nagid mazzala deattika kadisha, vetalyay minneh hahu mabbua dechachmeta (chaser), kad imma itmashshecha veitkelilat baavira dachya, hahu chivvavra nakit imma (chaser), venitzotza alat venafkat, veitachad da beda, veitavidat chad tikkuna.
Vechad itzterich salleka da al da, veitkasseya chad mikkamme chada. uvegin kach kolla itzterich, chad lemebad nukemin. vechad lerachama. veal hay taiv lehay dikna david malka, kema deokimna.

Behay dikna 9 tikkunin ishtechachu, shita rivvavn detalyayn behu, umitpashshetin bechol gufa. veillen shitta detalyayn, talyayn besaare ditchot takruva devusemin. telat mehay sitra, utelat mehay sitra. uveyakiruta dedikna, talyayn telat acharanin. chad leella besifvavn, uteren beinnun saarin detalyayn ad tabbura. vechol hane shitta, 3 mikkan veg mikkan, itmashshechan vetalyayn kullehon, beinnun sare detalyayn umitpashshetin bechol gufa.

Uvegin dehane telata innun beyakiru dedikna yattir mikkullehu, ketiv behu shema kadisha. dichtiv, (Tehillim 118:5-6) min hammetzar karati yah, anani vamerchav yah, Adonai li lo ira. veha deokimna beidara, min hammetzar karati yah, meatar deshare dikna leitpashsheta, dehu atar (sefer acher dachek) rachik mikkamme udenin, shappir hu.

Uvesifra deagadta deve rav yeva sava, hachi amar veokim, desheruta dedikna mechesed illaa, dichtiv, (divrei hayamim 1 29:11) lecha Adonai haggedula vehagevura vehattiferet vegomer. vecholla hu, vehachi share, vetisha itmashshechan vetalyayn bedikna, umikkamme udenin, hachi share, vekiyyuma la mitkayyeymin ella baatar ochora, kema deokimna.

Vechad itzterich alma lerachame, itgalyay mazzala kadisha. vechol hane tikkunin divdikna yakkira dizer anpin, kullehu rachame mishtachche. vechad itzterich ledina, mitchazzeyay dina, ucheden avdin nukemin lesanehon deyisrael, leinnun deakin lehu. kol yekiru dedikna, beinnun sare detalyayn inhu, mishshum decholla behay talyayn.
1565: Kol hane sare dedikna dizer anfin, kullehu keshishin takkifin, mishshum dechullehu achpeyayn ledinin, beshaata demazzala kadisha itgele. vechad baa leagacha kerava, behay dikna itchaze kegibbar takkif, mare natzchan keravayya. ucheden marit man demarit, veaglish man deaglish.

Hane tisha tikkunin, amaran moshe zimna tinyayna, beshaata deitzterich leahadra lon kullehu rachame. deaf al gav ditlesar tikkunin la amaran hasheta, bechavvavna talyay milleta, deha la yeul behane tikkunin leadkera, ella bemazzala itkevvavn, veadkar leh. hada hu dichtiv, (Bamidbar 14:17) atta yigdal na koach Adonai. man koach Adonai. hahu deikre mazzala kadisha, setima dechol setimin. dechilla da, unehiru da, mimmazzala tale. vechevan deamar moshe da, veadkar da, veitkevvavn beh, amar hane tisha tikkunin, detalyayn bizer anpin. begin deyanhiru kullehu, vela yishtechach dina. veal da kolla bemazzala tale.

Hay dikna kad sharan sare (sefer acher leitarva) leitara (laataarakea), itchaze kegibbar takkif kegibbar mare natzach keravin. behay dikna, nagid meshach dirvut meattika setimaa. kema deat amer, (Tehillim 133:2) kashshemen hattov al harosh yored al hazzakan zekan aharon.

Illen sare la chafyayn al sifvavn, vesifvavn kullehu sumakin kevavrda. dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim Adonai:13) siftotav shoshannim. sifvavn merachshan gevura, merachshan chachmeta. beinnun sifvavn talyayn tav uvish, chayye umota. meillen sifvavn talyayn marehon deataruta, dechad merachashin illen sifvavn, mitarin kolla lemigzar (mare) dina, bechol batte dinin, (damedaverayhaven behon, uvegin kach) deikrun irin. dichtiv, (Daniel 4:14) bigzerat irin pitgama uvememar vegomer. (uvememar kaddishin sheelta)

May ir. besifra deagadta, kema deat amer, (Shmuel 1 28:16) vayhi arecha. demitarin dinin leinnun dela itrechimu leella, begin kach mitarin illen deinnun mare devavu, (sefer acher lehu) (bechullehu) veim kol da bitre gevavne berachame vedina, veal da ikrun ir vekaddish dina verachame.

Uveillen sifvavn, itchaze puma kad itpetach. rucha denafik min puma, beh mitlabbeshshin kama elef verivvan. vechad itpeshshat, mitlabbeshshin beh nevian mehemne. vechullehu pe Adonai ikrun. kad millin nafkin min puma, umitrachashin besifvavn, mitnaharin lechullehu timne sare alfin almin, ad demitkatterin kullehu kachada, betamnesar orchin ushevilin, deishtemodan.

Vecholla mechakkan lefuma da, (beda) belishan memallel ravrevan bekitra detihara beutera. veal da ketiv, (Shir HaShirim Adonai:16) chikko mamtakkim, mamtakkim vadday. may chikko. kema deat amer, (Iyov 34:3) vechech yitam leechol. vechullo machamaddim, esh umayim. eshsha umayay mittaknan, (sefer acher mitdabbekin vayan) yaan betziyyyuroy, (batzeyveravey) deha gevavne mitchabberan kachada.

1580: Kol chad kedka chaze leh veavad adam deshallit becholla beillae vetattae.

Veta chaze ad la ashlimu inun sheva dargin yomin illain la ishtelim adam leela. kevan deishtelim leela adam illaa, ishtelim letatta adam tattaa. vechulhu almin vishlimu. begin kach shalte leadam tattaa al kol deitbare bealma begin deadam illaa shalit al kolla. uvegin kach ramaz behay kera sheva dargin. deit beh sheva dargin illain deikre behu adam dilela veishtelim behu. begin kach naase adam betzalmenu, lemehav leh shefa mehahu atra deikre chesed.

1582: Keneset yisrael ittemar kad ihi sharyay beara bechol inun shiva yomin kullehu vishlimu hada hu dichtiv (Vayikra 8:33) shivat yamim yemmale et yeddechem uvegin kach ikrun shivat yeme hamiluim dayyka.

Umoshe deihu levi missitra da kariv bekadmita legabbe hay mizbeach. hada hu dichtiv semolo tachat leroshi may roshi ella beresha kad itdabbekat hay mizbeach behahu ola semolo itkere bekadmita, veim kol da itaru chavrayyay bechaluk lavan sheen bo imra shimmesh. hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 30:37) machsof hallavan asher al hamaklot. begin deaf al gav deihu missitra dedina itlabbash bechesed vekariv legabbah veitar chesed illaa bealma.

Umay kariv par beresha tamid shel shachar ola vadday. ulevatar kariv par chattat lemehav shelama ben hahu par chattat veaharon dechav legabbah kad avad egla (sefer acher ola) veda keneset yisrael vehachatat lekobbela ihu. veda par kohen mashiach kad ihu chav legabbe mizbeach ma dela it begever achara ella nukevta lechattat ulevatar kariv ola legabbah. kevan deitkeriv ola legabbe hay mizbeach keden miluim hu. miluim leela miluim letatta vechulhu almin bechedva, deha matronita itchabberat bevalah ucheden kariv legabbe hahu mizbeach el hamiluim. veyahiv mehahu dama al tanoch udena deaharon begin dethve rechicha lemishma birchichu vela bekashyu. viykabbel mille deorayyta dela leafrada tora shebbeal pe mittora shebbichtav uleashlama almin kullehu vechen livnoy.

Nishmat hazachar, min hazachar. venishmat hanekeva, min hanekeva. vehayeynu deka azil nachash batra dechavva. amar, hoil venishmata min hatztzafon asitena mehera. umay hasata hava, mishum deba aleh. shaalu talmidoy, ovada hechi hava. amar lahem, samael harasha kashar im kol tzevaot mala al rabbo. mishum deamar kudesha berich hu, uredu bidgat hayyam uveof hashshamayim. amar, heach uchal lehachetio ulegarsho milfanav. yarad im kol chayyaylotav uvikesh lo baaretz chaver kemoto umanu nachash, vehaya lo demut gamal. rachav alav uva lo etzel haisha.

Amar lah, af ki amar elohim lo tochlu mikkol etz haggan. amar avakesh yoter veosif, kede shetigra hi. amra, lo menaanu ella meetz haddaat asher betoch haggan amar elohim lo tochlu mimmennu velo tigu bo pen temutun. vehosifa 2 devarim, amra mipperi haetz asher betoch haggan amar elohim lo tochlu, velo neemar lah ella meetz haddaat. veamra, lo tigu pen temutun.

Ma asa samael harasha halach venaga beilan vahava hailan tzoviach veomer (Tehillim 36:12) al tevoeni regel gaava veyad reshaim al tenideni, al tigga bi. shenneemar veyad reshaim al tenideni. halach veamar leisha, hare nagati beilan vela matti, af at tigi beilan velo tamuti. halcha haisha venaga beilan veraata malach hammavet ba kenegda, amra ulay achshav ani meta, vehakkadosh baruch hu ose lo ishsha acheret venotna leadam hareni goremet lo sheyochal imi im namut, namut shenenu. veim nichyye, nichyye sheninu. velakcha mippiryo venattena gam levala,

Ma haya levusho shel adam or shel tzipporen, vehifshito mealav. raa atzmo erom, shenneemar mi higgid lecha ki erom atta. amar adam lifni hakkadosh baruch hu, ribbono shel olam, keshehayiti levaddi shemma chatati lecha, ella haisha shehevetta li hi hedicha oti middevarecha. shenneemar haisha asher natatta immadi hi nattena li min haetz.

Amar lah hakkadosh baruch hu, lo dayyech shechattat ella shehechetet leadam. amra lefanav ribbono shel olam, hannachash hishiani lachato lefanecha. hevi shelashtan vegazar alehen gezerot din 9 kelalot umavet vehippil samael veet hakkat shello mimakom kedushatan min hashamayim, vekitzetz raglav shel nachash veirro mikkol chayya umikkol behema ufakkad alav sheyyihye mafshit et oro achar sheva shanim. ad kan:
1593: (Yeshayahu 55:1) uvela mechir yayin vechalav, ma inyan ze etzel ze. ella melammed shehayyayin hu pachad vechalav hu chesed. umippeni ma hizkir yayin techila, mippene shehu karov elenu yoter, yayin vechalav salka datach, ella ema demut yayin vechalav. ad kan.

Rabbi chiyyay amar meolam da havu, veguverin gibbarin desitra visha havu, dichtiv anshe hashem. anshe shem la ketiv, ella anshe hashem kegoona da ketiv, zechor rachamecha Adonai vachasaddecha ki meolam hemma, meolam vadday natal lon kudesha berich hu, veinun avahan kadmae lemeheve reticha kaddisha leela. amar rabbi yitzchak meolam da ihu mittato shelishloma dichtiv vechulei:

Vayyomer elohim yehi or, veamar rabbi yochanan shene orim haggedolim hayu, dichtiv vayhi or. vealav neemar ki tov. velakach hakkadosh baruch hu haechad ugenazo latztzaddikim leatid lavo dichtiv ma rav tuvecha asher tzafanta lireecha paalta lachosim bach neged bene adam.

Melammed sheor harishon en kol birya yechola lehistakkel bo dichtiv vayyar elohim et haor ki tov vayyar elohim et kol asher asa vehinne tov meod. raa hakkadosh baruch hu et kol asher asa, raa tov meod, mazhir ubbahir. velakach meoro hattov vechalal sheloshim ushetayim netivot hachachma unetano leolam hazze.

Vehayeynu dichtiv (Mishlei 4:2) ki lekach tov natatti lachem toratti al taazovu. heve omer otzara shel tora shebbeal pe. veamar hakkadosh baruch hu, im yishmeru zot hammidda baolam hazze shezot hammidda nechshevet bichlal haolam hazze, vehi tora shebbeal pe. yizku lechayye haolam habba shehu hattov hagganuz. umay nihu uzo shel hakkadosh baruch hu,

Dichtiv (Chavakuk 3:4) venoga kaor tihye. atid hannoga shenilkach mehaor harishon lihyot kaor, im yekayymu banay hattora vehammitzva asher kattavti lehorottam. uchetiv (Mishlei 1:8) shema beni musar avicha veal titosh torat immecha.

Uchetiv (Chavakuk 3:4) karnayim miyyado lo vesham chevyon uzzo, umay chevyon uzzo. ella oto haor sheganaz vehechbi shenneemar (tehillim 34) tzafanta lireecha, veze shenishar lanu. (tehillim 34) paalta lachosim bach, otam shechosim betzillecha baolam hazze veshomrim torattecha umekayymim mitzvottecha umekaddeshim shimcha haggadol umeyyaychaddim basseter uvaggaluy, shenneemar, neged bene adam.

Amar rabbi rechumay, melammed shehi ora leyisrael vetora ora. shenneemar, (Mishlei 6:23) ki ner mitzva vetora or, veamar ner zo mitzva. umitzva zo tora shebbeal pe. or, zo tora shebbichtav. ella mittoch shekkevar nitkayaym haor kare lah or. mashal lema haddavar dome leadam tzanua besife habbayit af al pi sheyom hu veor gadol baolam, en adam roe betoch beto ella im ken hichnis bo ner. ner tora shebbeal pe, af al pi shehi ner, tzericha lah tora lefarek kushioteha ulevaer sodotteha.

Umay nihu yirat Adonai, ze haor harishon. deamar Rabbi meir mahu dichtiv vayyomer elohim yehi or vayhi or vela amar leh vayhi chen. melammed shehaor hahu gadol veen kol birya yechola lehistakkel bo. genazo hakkadosh baruch hu latztzaddikim leatid lavo

Vehi middat kol sechora shebbaolam vehu koach even yekara shekorin socharet. vedar veal ma hi middat dar, ella melammed shelakach hakkadosh baruch hu miziva achat mealpayim, uvana mimmenna even yekara naa umekushetet vechalal bah kol hammitzvot. ba avraham uvikesh kocho latet lo, natnu lo even yekara zo velo ratza otah, zacha venatal midatto shenneemar (Micha 7:20) titten emet loyaakov chesed leavraham.

Ba yitzchak uvikesh kocho venatnu lo, velo ratza bah. zacha venatal midatto shehi middat haggevura dehayynu happachad. dichtiv (Bereshit 31:53-54) vayyishava yaakov befachad aviv yitzchak. ba yaakov veratza bah velo netanuhu lo, amar leh hoil vavraham milmala veyitzchak lematta, atta tihye beemtza vetichlol shelashtam dichtiv titten emet loyaakov.

Umay emtza, hayeynu shalom. veha ketiv titten emet leyaakov, emet veshalom chad havi. kema deat amer (Ester 9:30) divre shalom veemet (ysheayhatel) ki shalom veemet yihye bime vehayeynu dichtiv (Yeshayahu 58:14) vehaachalticha nachalat yaakov avicha. dehayynu nachala gemura deit leh hachesed vehappachad vehaemet vehashalom.
Ulefikkach amar (Tehillim 118:22) even maasu habbonim hayta lerosh pina. even maasu avraham vyitzchak shebanu et haolam, hayta atta lerosh pina. velamma maasu bah vahalo
1594: Neemar (Bereshit 26:5) ekev asher shama avraham bekoli vayishmor mishmarti mitzvotay chukotay vetorotay. may mishmarti, amar middat chesed. kol yeme hyot avraham baolam lo hutzerachti ani laasot melachti, shehare avraham amad sham bimkomi. vayishmor mishmarti, bemidda zo hayta melachti sheani mezakke et haolam kullo veafilu nitchayyvu, ani mezakke otam.

Veod meshivam umevi bilvavam laasot ratzon avihem. kol ze asa avraham uchetiv (Bereshit 21:33) vayyitta eshel biver shava. sider lachmo umemav lechol bae olam vehaya mezakke umedabber al libbam, lemi attem ovdim, ivdu et Adonai elohe hashamayim vehaaretz. vehaya doresh lahem, ad shehayu baim veshavim.

Umenalan sheaf hachayavim haya mezakke, shenneemar hamechasse ani meavraham veavraham hayo yihye vegomer. ella azakkehu sheyvakkess alehem rachamim veyizke. vechi efshar lomar shello yada hakkadosh baruch hu shello yachlu lehinatzel. ella zechuto kaamar. mikkan amru ba litaher mesayyin oto. ba litame potchin lo may potchin lo, otan happetuchim tamid.
Mitzvotay chukotay vetorotay, amar, hoil velo chafatzti bah eshmor mitzvoteha. may torotay, ella afilu horaot uppilpulim shemmurim lemala, hu yedaam ufilpel vekiyymam.

Umay misham roe even yisrael, heve omer tzedek haelyon. umay haor haggadol hatztzafun, hayeynu socharet. vehaeven shedara lematta hemmena nikret dar, umay hu miyado lo, hayeynu chamesh etzbaot shel yad yamin:

Sheva tzurot kedoshot yesh lo lehakkadosh baruch hu vechulan kenegedan baadam, shenneemar betzelem elohim bara oto zachar unekeva bara otam. veellu hen shok yamin ushemol. yad yemin ushemol guf uverit hare shesh. veha amarta shiva. sheva have beishto vehayu levasar echad.

Mashal lema haddavar dome, lemelech sheala belibbo lita begano tisha ilanin zecharim vehayu kullam dekalim, amar keshyihyu kullam min echad, i efshar lehitkayyem. ma asa, nata etrog beynehem vehu echad meotan hatisha sheala belibbo lihyot zecharim veetrog may have, nekeva vehayeynu dichtiv (Vayikra 23:40) peri etz hadar kappot temarim (ad kan).

Zachar unekeva beraam. efshar lomar ken veha ketiv vayyivra elohim et haadam betzalmo betzelem elohim bara oto vegomer veachar kach eese lo ezer kenegdo. vayyikkach achat mitztzalotav vayisgor basar tachtena. ella ema, dichtiv yetzira uchetiv bahen asiyya uchetiv bahen beria. asiyya dichtiv zachar unekeva bara otam, beet hirkiv hanneshama al hagguf veasaf hakkol. umenalan dehay yetzira lishna deasofe hu dichtiv, vayyyitzer Adonai elohim kol chayyat hassade vechol of hashamayim vayyave el haadam, vehayeynu dichtiv al haadam zachar unekeva beraam vayvarech otam (ad kan).

Betzelem elohim bara oto bechol evarav vechol chalakav, veha amrinan vav ulema hu dome leote or kassalma vehay vav ena ella shesh ketzavot. amar leh, berit mila vezivugo shel haadam chashvenan echad. shete yadav 3. rosho vegufo Adonai. shete shokav 6. ukkengedam kemotam bashamayim dichtiv (Kohelet 7:14) gam et ze leummat ze asa haelohim. vehayeynu yammim (Shemot 31:17) ki sheshet yammim asa Adonai et hashamayim veet haaretz velo amar besheshet yammim melammed shekkol yom vayom yesh lo kocho (ad kan):

Vayyomer elohim peru urevu vegomer. fikkuda da leitaska behay alma befirya verivya ulemeebbad toladin leitpashsheta shemma kaddisha lechol sitrin ulemilkkat ruchin venishmatin lemeheve yekara dekudesha berich hu ela vetatta. dechol man dela itassak befirya verivya azir diyyukena demareh dela ishtechach behay alma. vegarim dela sharyay shechinta behay alma dekma deitosfan ruchin venishmatin, hachi ittosaf lenachata (nusach acher davegametaa) behay alma ziv yekara demalka dichtiv (Mishlei 14:28) berov am hadrat melech ubbeefes leom machtat razon.

Hadrat melech da ziv yekara demalka deittosaf lenachata behay alma, machtat razon da zeiru dediyyukena demalka deazir mehay alma, hachi azir meela. deha hahu ziva la nachit, veitchashav al hahu bar nash keilu oshid damin degara diyyukena diltatta kegoona dilela dichtiv ki betzelem elohim asa et haadam, veihu azir tzelem elohim letatta, udemut udeyukena leela. veal da itzterich bar nash leitaska befirya verivya ulemeevad tzelem elohim leasgaa yekara dAdonai bechol sitrin:

Raya mehemna fikkuda da lekayyim pirya verivya lekayyem ben uvat. begin deav tamman 10, veem tamman Adonai, ben tamman 6, bat tamman Adonai. vav vem delet lon ben uvat, gam Adonai la sharya alayyhu, uchegavvna da beovada debreshit amar peru urevu. peru missitra diymina urevu missitra dismala debeh bara elokim kolla, uvera da ammuda deemtztzaita. et haaretz da shechinta. vammay tzarich 4, beav veem ben uvat. begin deha itkadashu veitbarchu beshalosh kedushot vesheva birchaan deinnun 10, tzerichin lemehevi 4 atvvn desharyayn alayyhu asara, lemehevi bar nash reshut hayyachid lemareh, derachbo 4 vgavho 10.

(Tehillim 127:1) im Adonai lo yivne bayit shav amlu bonav bo, may shav amlu bonav bo, inun sammael venachash ad kan:

Yashav rabbi berachya vedarash may hay deka amrinan kol yoma haolam habba, velo yadinan may kaamar, haolam habba metargem alma deate melammed shekodem shennivra haolam ala bemachshava livro or gadol lehair venivra or gadol sheen kol birya yechola lishlot bo, tzafa hakkadosh baruch hu sheenan yecholin lesovlo lakach shevii vesam lahem bimkomo vehashear genazo latztzaddikim leatid lavo. amar im yizku baze hashevii veyishmeruhu, etten lahem ze leolam acharon. vehayeynu dichtiv, haolam habba. shekkevar ba mikodem sheshet yeme berishit. hada hu dichtiv, (sham 31) ma rav tuvecha asher tzafanta lireecha paalta lachosim bach neged bene adam:

Shemini may have, yesh lo lohakkadosh baruch hu tzaddik echad baolam vechaviv lo mippene shemkayyem kol haolam kullo vehu yesodo vehu mechalkelo umatzmicho umegaddelo umesamcho. ahuv vechaviv lemala, nora veaddir lematta. metukan umekubbal lemala, metukan umekubbal lematta. vehu yesod hanefashot kullam.

Amarta shemini veamarta yesod hanefashot kullam, veha ketiv uveyom hashevii shabbat vayyinnafash. in shevii havi, ella mishum demachria benayyhu, veyesh inun telat lera utelat leel, vehu deachra benayyhu.

Umay tama ikre shevii, vechi hu bashvii, lo. ella mippene shohakkadosh baruch hu shavat beshabbat beota hammidda. dichtiv (Shemot 31:17) ki sheshet yamim asa Adonai et hashamayim veet haaretz uvayom hashevii shabbat vayyinnafash. melammed shekkol yom vayom yesh lo maamar echad shehu adon lo, lo mippene shehu nivra bo, ella mippeni shehu poel baolam peula hamesura lo beyado. paalu kullam peulatam vekiyyemu maasehem levad, ba yom hashevii ufaal peulato. samchu kullam veaf hakkadosh baruch hu. velo od ella shegadla nishmato, dichtiv uveyom hashevii shabbat vayyinnafash.

Umay have shevita zo dela have bah melacha, vahave hanacha. dichtiv shabbat. mashal lema haddavar dome, lemelech shehayu lo shiva ganot, uvaggan haemtzai mayan nae novea mimakor mayim chayyim, 3 mimino 9 mismolo. umiyyad shoppoel baolam, az mitmale vesmechim kullam. veomrim letzorchenu hu mitmale vehu mashke otam umeggadlam vehem mamtinin veshovtin vehu mashke et hashiva.

Veha ketiv (Yeshayahu 43:5) mimmizrach avi zaracha vahave chad minhon umashke leh. ella ema hu mashke et hallev vehallev mashke achar ken kullam. umay nihu midda sheviit hve omer zo middat tuvo shel hakkadosh baruch hu.

May tama amar et shabbetotay, velo amar et shabbatay. mashal lema haddavar dome, lemelech shehaya lo challa naa vechol shavua veshavua mazmina yom echad lihyot immo. vehammelech yesh lo banim naim veahuvim amar lahem hoil vechen simchu attem gam ken beyom simchati ki ani beshlachem ani mishtaddel veattem gam ken hadru oto.
